text: “Not till we are lost, in other words, not till we have lost the world, do we begin to find ourselves.”
Thoreau wrote about losing the world
When the usual map stops working,
you notice what you were following.
You do not need the whole route.
You need the next honest step.
Today, sit quietly for five minutes
and ask where you actually are.
Where do you feel a little lost right now?

A short daily practice for seeing yourself clearly.
